author: anon-df5e95db
content: Architectural decision: the entire BAM I/O stack depends on BGZF compression. Options: (1) bgzf crate — lightweight, focused on BGZF blocks, (2) noodles-bgzf — part of the noodles ecosystem, well-tested, (3) roll our own with flate2. This evaluation should benchmark read/write throughput vs htslib's BGZF and decide which crate to adopt. Blocks all BAM I/O replacements.
